request_without_reference_paths.prompt: Create ONE original standalone STRATEGY-GAME FIGURINE for the SAME knowledge-city civilization as the supplied Memory Archive image. That image is a BUILDING: use it only as a strict material and craftsmanship reference — warm pale limestone, dark slate ceramic, aged copper-bronze with contained turquoise patina, subtle warm amber — NOT as a silhouette to copy. The subject is a compact stylized standing humanoid inhabitant with a slightly large head for map readability, full body, feet together. Handcrafted stylized finish, sophisticated proportions rather than photorealism, medieval fantasy, anime or chibi. Thick connected sculptural pieces, no thin fingers, railings or filigree, no text, logos, extra people, gears, dramatic baked shadows, excessive grime, floating pieces or surrounding scenery. No terrain hex. A tiny circular limestone figurine plinth under the feet is allowed. Show the complete standalone figurine in one clearly ELEVATED THREE-QUARTER ISOMETRIC view, with both front and side visible, all edges inside frame, neutral background and transparent cutout. Readable at small strategy-map scale. Unit Ranger: a compact scout of the knowledge city. Limestone tunic, a slate hood and backpack, a copper cylindrical map-case at the hip. No daggers, no bow, no quiver, no cape flourish. Read clearly as a ranger-messenger, not a rogue, assassin, coordinator, builder or guardian.
